feeds.title: Lincoln Land Conservation
feeds.description: The Lincoln Land Conservation Trust (LLCT) IS Lincoln's non-profit conservation organization, which works to acquire and protect the land. Follow this blog to know more about land conservation.

feeds.title: Davidson Lands Conservancy
feeds.description: Davidson Lands Conservancy includes protecting, exploring, and supporting Davidson's natural environments. Get more information about land conservation by following this feed.

feeds.title: Piscataquog Land Conservancy
feeds.description: The Piscataquog Land Conservancy (PLC) is a private, non-profit land conservation organization in the Merrimack Valley of southern New Hampshire. Follow for more updates on land conservation.

feeds.title: Lake George Land Conservancy
feeds.description: The Lake George Land Conservancy (LGLC) is a not-for-profit land trust that works solely within the Lake George watershed in the southeastern corner of New York's Adirondack Park. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: The Land Conservancy of BC
feeds.description: TLC The Land Conservancy of British Columbia is a non-profit, charitable Land Trust working throughout B.C. The Land Conservancy achieves its conservation objectives by working in a non-confrontational, businesslike manner. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: Connecticut Land Conservation Council
feeds.description: Stay up on the latest news, conservation conversation, conservation tips, policy, project updates, and events. Connecticut Land Conservation Council (CLCC) advocates for land conservation, stewardship and funding, and works to ensure the long-term strength and viability of the land conservation community.

feeds.title: Ozark Regional Land Trust
feeds.description: The Ozark Regional Land Trust is part of a rapidly expanding land conservation movement throughout the United States that now includes more than 1,700 land trusts. Follow to get the latest articles from this feed in your inbox.

feeds.title: OVLC
feeds.description: The OVLC is a nonprofit, non-governmental, land protection organization supported by private donations. Follow this blog to know more about land conservation.

feeds.title: Land Trust Alliance
feeds.description: Founded in 1982, the Land Trust Alliance works to save the places people need and love by strengthening land conservation across America. Follow to get regular updates from this blog in your inbox.

feeds.title: Foothills Land Conservancy
feeds.description: Foothills Land Conservancy is dedicated to protecting, preserving, and enhancing the lands and environments of the Southern Appalachian region and promoting the character of the land for the benefit of the general public, now and in the future.
